name: IconPicker
description:
A searchable grid of icons. The grid is one tab stop: arrow keys move through it in reading
order, Home and End go to its ends, Enter or Space picks, and typing returns to the search. ↓
enters the grid from the search, and Enter there picks the first result. Searches match names
and the words people use for an icon (GPU finds ground-power).
signature: ({ value, defaultValue, onValueChange, icons, autoFocus, className, "aria-label": label, ...rest }: IconPickerProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the search when the picker mounts.

props.name: icons
props.description: The icons to offer, in order. Default every icon (`iconCatalogue`); pass a filtered copy to offer fewer.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the name a person picks by click, Enter or Space.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen icon's name ("air-start"), controlled; null for none.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
